This role will support the Marketing Planning and Strategy team by developing and operationalizing automated reporting processes that impact the marketing organization. This individual will support the dynamic growth of the business through the design, standardization, and harmonization of data across our internal systems that allows marketing to work faster and smarter. Proficient in Tableau desktop or similar data visualization tool (ability to perform calculations, parameters, etc)

Drive project management and stakeholder management for all owned product learning content, ensuring seamless communication across product and field readiness teams.

Create scalable content for a global audience, producing learning that applies across multiple industries and geos, and finding innovative ways to tailor material for different learner profiles. 

Anticipate and understand changing product, audience and business drivers and adapt to meet those needs.

Are you passionate about shaping the future of B2B commerce? We’re looking for a collaborative and dedicated Solution Engineer to drive growth across our B2B Commerce Cloud and Order Management (OMS) offerings.
As a trusted technical and business advisor, you will collaborate closely with our Commerce Sales teams to understand customer needs and craft tailored solutions that solve the complex challenges of our diverse customers. Whether it’s transforming B2B buyer relationships, enabling seamless self-service portals, or supporting end-to-end fulfillment, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving customer success on our innovative platform.

Your Role Will Be Divided Into The Following Activities:

Direct Customer Engagements: You will work on business opportunities, from discovery to tailored product demonstrations and presentations showcasing our solutions’ value.

Understand and map customer goals to the Salesforce product portfolio, designing innovative solutions and visions that address complex B2B challenges (e.g., account hierarchies, custom pricing, re-ordering, and unified order routing).

Provide technical expertise during the sales process, addressing customer questions and concerns in close collaboration with Solution Engineers and Account Executives.

Present our Commerce technology with confident familiarity of our B2B and Order Management capabilities.

Lead technical discussions with various partners, from C-level executives to IT teams, articulating the business value and architectural viability of our solutions.

Industry & Product Innovation: Stay abreast of B2B industry trends and market opportunities, using your expertise to drive product innovation and solve complex technical problems alongside global, multi-functional teams.

1-to-Many Internal and External Sessions: Share thought leadership and solution knowledge by running live sessions such as webinars, masterclasses, campfires, and internal enablement to drive solution awareness, platform adoption, and ultimate customer success.

Asset Creation: Create highly relevant and reusable assets such as videos, pitch decks, and demo environments to allow others to self-serve, wow customers, and showcase visionary solutions.

Continuous Learning: Bring a strong growth mindset and an inherent curiosity to your role. Take ownership of your personal development through certifications, product training, and independent exploration. We help you to constantly learn, evolve, and thrive in a rapidly changing technological landscape.

Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 4+ years of experience in a similar customer-facing role such as Solution/Sales Engineering, B2B E-Commerce architecture, or technical consulting, with a strong focus on commerce technology and transforming complex buyer journeys.

Language Skills: Fluency in both German and English is required.

Generate new business pipeline primarily through prospecting outbound opportunities

Nurture early-stage opportunities

Gain interest through outbound cold calling across a set of existing Salesforce customers and breaking into net new logos in assigned territory

Align with internal account team

Identify key decision makers within new accounts

1-2 years experience in business development, sales or related field experience
